provenance.evidence: EquiVM run 5 residue, Examples/TinyImmutable/Constructor.lean 934: `simp` then `rw [show (⟨160⟩ : UInt256).toNat = 160 from by decide]` fails with `No goals to be solved`. The adopt commit efbfb862 added `@[simp] u256_toNat_lit160` to Reasoning/Solc.lean, so `simp` closes the goal and the `rw` after it does nothing. Measured on a copy of the target file: deleting the `rw` leaves the module with no error. The node is `rw`, not `any`: at this site the innermost node at the error is the `[…]` rule list, and `any` would delete only the list.
